meta.purpose: Decision variables distilled from high-visibility tutorials/community questions, with money/risk-critical claims anchored to current first-party evidence.
meta.rule: Tutorials discover the questions. Official sources decide hard rules. Community exceptions never override an official restriction.

evidenceClass.label: Official rules + explicit overseas-use caution
evidenceClass.note: The six-month inactivity rule is official, but it is not the same as permission for permanent overseas use. Current giffgaff terms separately caution against first use outside the UK and prolonged non-UK usage patterns.

overseasPolicy.label: Keep-alive does not remove long-term overseas-use risk
overseasPolicy.note: A qualifying keep-alive action can reset inactivity, but users living abroad long term should not treat that as proof the line is low-risk for permanent non-UK use.

numberDuration.label: Durable carrier line while account rules are satisfied
numberDuration.note: This is a real carrier number, not a one-time activation number; inactivity and overseas-use policies still apply.

termination.label: Inactivity deactivation cannot be reversed; port-out window may remain
termination.note: After inactivity deactivation the SIM cannot be reactivated. giffgaff says a PAC may be requested from agents within 30 days to move the number to another UK network.

evidenceClass.label: Officially restricted for first activation outside the US
evidenceClass.note: Current Tello support requires first activation/port-in while physically in the US and connected to US cellular towers.

overseasPolicy.label: Overseas use supported after US activation
overseasPolicy.note: After the US activation prerequisite is completed, Tello documents international roaming plus Wi-Fi Calling & Text abroad.

communityObservation.label: Community exceptions exist, but are not the supported route
communityObservation.note: Some community posts report successful activation while abroad under particular conditions. Treat these as anecdotes, not a replacement for the current official US-activation requirement.

numberDuration.label: Renewable carrier line
numberDuration.note: Long-term control depends on keeping the paid line active and maintaining recovery access.

evidenceClass.label: Official Japanese voice-number route with identity conditions
evidenceClass.note: Mobal documents a real 070/080/090 Japanese mobile number, voice-product ID checks and activation flow.

numberAssignment.label: Number is assigned after activation
numberAssignment.note: Do not assume you know the Japanese phone number at checkout. Mobal says the number is allocated when service is activated.

termination.label: Termination loses the assigned number
termination.note: Mobal states that terminating the service loses the phone number; a future service gets a new number.

numberDuration.label: Monthly carrier-style number
numberDuration.note: Suitable for a real Japanese number need, but only while the service remains active.

evidenceClass.label: Official Voice+Data route for non-residents with passport conditions
evidenceClass.note: Sakura documents Voice+Data applications for non-residents. Passport-based applications require face-to-face identity verification/pickup.

numberAssignment.label: Voice number is part of the activated Voice+Data service
numberAssignment.note: Treat the number as unavailable until the identity/activation flow is completed; the MVP does not claim a number is assigned at checkout.

termination.label: Post-cancellation number recovery not yet verified
termination.note: Do not cancel a number tied to important accounts until the current Sakura cancellation/porting rules are verified and recovery has been migrated.

numberDuration.label: Monthly Voice+Data number
numberDuration.note: This is a real voice/SMS route rather than a tourist data-only eSIM.

evidenceClass.label: Comparison layer, not a durable carrier relationship
evidenceClass.note: Use it to compare current service/country/supplier availability and price; ownership/refund/privacy ultimately depend on the selected supplier route.

numberDuration.label: Temporary activation route
numberDuration.note: Do not assume future control of the number unless the selected downstream product explicitly provides a rental/longer-duration service.

privacy.label: Privacy depends on the selected supplier
privacy.note: Do not treat all temporary-number products as equivalent to a private long-term number; check whether the selected route is public, shared, one-time or rented.

refund.label: Refund rule depends on the selected supplier
refund.note: The comparison layer does not justify a universal 'failed = refunded' claim. Read the exact supplier cancellation/no-code rule before buying.

evidenceClass.label: Marketplace rules documented by the provider
evidenceClass.note: SMSPool documents separate one-time SMS, rental and data-eSIM products, plus service/country/pool selection.

numberDuration.label: One-time by default; rental is a separate product
numberDuration.note: A one-time activation order does not give durable access to the same number. Choose a rental only when later access is actually required.

privacy.label: Account/order workflow, not a free public inbox page
privacy.note: The paid order workflow should still not be interpreted as permanent exclusivity or long-term ownership of the number.

refund.label: No-code orders have documented automatic refund behavior
refund.note: SMSPool states that an order with no received code is automatically refunded after the order period. Deposit/balance refunds follow separate conditions.

evidenceClass.label: Marketplace purchase/refund rules documented by the provider
evidenceClass.note: 5SIM documents service-country-operator selection, pricing, API access and refund/support rules.

numberDuration.label: Ordinary activation is temporary; rentals are separate
numberDuration.note: Do not use an ordinary one-time order for an account that may need the same phone number again.

privacy.label: Account/order workflow, not a free public inbox page
privacy.note: A paid activation order still does not mean durable ownership of the number.

refund.label: Refund depends on the failure mode
refund.note: Cancelled/non-implemented orders can be returned under 5SIM rules and incorrect-code cases have support procedures. A target account later being banned is not the same as an SMS delivery failure and should not be presented as automatically refundable.

tello-us.outsideHomeNote: Current official Tello support requires first activation/port-in in the United States on US cellular towers. Some community reports describe exceptions, but the MVP does not recommend those anecdotes as the supported buying route.

sakura-japan-voice-data.summary: For the passport/non-resident Voice+Data route, Sakura documents face-to-face identity verification/pickup in Japan before the voice-number service can be completed.
sakura-japan-voice-data.outsideHomeNote: You can research/apply before arrival, but a passport-based non-resident voice-number route is not an immediate outside-Japan activation path because face-to-face identity verification/pickup is required.

additionalRoutes.name: Sakura Mobile Japan Voice+Data (passport route)
additionalRoutes.form: monthly Voice+Data SIM/eSIM with Japanese voice/SMS service; passport route requires face-to-face verification/pickup

cost.purchase: Plan, activation and initial charges are dynamic; recheck the current official application page before paying.
cost.recurring: Monthly Voice+Data pricing varies by current plan. Do not compare it to a tourist data-only eSIM because the jobs are different.

retention.rule: Keep the monthly Voice+Data service active while important accounts depend on the Japanese number. Exact cancellation/porting consequences must be rechecked before ending service.
retention.recovery: Before cancellation, move important account recovery away from the number or verify the current porting/number-retention process.

friction.identity: Non-residents can use a passport for the documented Voice+Data route, but passport-based applications require face-to-face identity verification/pickup.
friction.location: The passport route can be researched/applied for before arrival, but completion requires face-to-face verification/pickup in Japan.
friction.device: Unlocked compatible phone required; confirm current SIM/eSIM and VoLTE/device support before purchase.
friction.ongoing: Monthly contract. Post-departure roaming/OTP behavior is not yet verified strongly enough for the MVP to promise.

evidence.label: Sakura Mobile — Travel SIM/eSIM is data-only

kyc.label: Passport accepted for non-resident route; face-to-face verification required
kyc.note: Sakura documents passport eligibility for non-residents, with face-to-face identity verification/pickup for passport-based Voice+Data applications.

roamingSms.label: Post-departure roaming SMS not yet verified
roamingSms.note: Do not assume the Japanese number will remain a reliable overseas OTP line after leaving Japan until the current Sakura roaming policy is verified.

wifiCallingAbroad.label: Wi-Fi Calling abroad not yet verified
wifiCallingAbroad.note: The MVP does not yet have first-party evidence to promise overseas Wi-Fi Calling/Text for this route.
